risks: Esri can close the gap natively (Data Pipelines, scheduled Sheets refresh), and it already owns the search results with 60% vendor share, nearly all esri.com hosts
Generic no-code map tools (iipmaps, Shareables, get-instamaps) and FME or Power Automate integrations already cover the non-AGOL and enterprise ends
No observed price point, and the buyers include many nonprofits and universities with small budgets
gis-surveying:spreadsheet_map_sync.name: Spreadsheet-to-map live sync
gis-surveying:spreadsheet_map_sync.idea: Connect a Google Sheet/Excel file and get an auto-updating hosted web map (or AGOL layer sync) with pop-ups and change history.
gis-surveying:spreadsheet_map_sync.pain: Teams keep data in Excel/Google Sheets/OneDrive and re-import, re-geocode and re-join it into GIS or AGOL layers by hand; there is no live sync, incremental merge or custom pop-up hosting.

risks: Free substitutes already cover parts of the bundle (QGIS Topology Checker and Geometry Checker, GRASS v.clean, the built-in Create Grid, free centerline plugins), so willingness to pay is weak
Search results are dominated by plugins.qgis.org and content sites, and the listed 'incumbents' are free directories, not paid vendors, so there is no proven paid demand and discovery is hard
Esri ArcGIS users, who are more willing to pay, already have Esri's Redistricting and territory-design tools
gis-surveying:geometry_cleanup_tools.name: Topology & geometry processing toolkit
gis-surveying:geometry_cleanup_tools.idea: Paid QGIS plugin/web API bundling one-click topology repair, centerlines, oriented grids and balanced territory/district generation.
gis-surveying:geometry_cleanup_tools.pain: There are no easy batch tools for fixing topology gaps and overlaps, closing line gaps, extracting centerlines, simplifying while keeping shared edges, rotated plot grids, territory balancing, contiguous districting and gap-filling.

restaurants:recipe_costing.verdict: unviable — value per customer below the acquisition floor
restaurants:recipe_costing.name: Recipe & menu costing
restaurants:recipe_costing.idea: Upload recipes and supplier invoices, and AI builds live plate costs that flag menu items to reprice when ingredient prices move.
restaurants:recipe_costing.pain: Owners cost recipes and plates in fragile, hand-built spreadsheets. They can't track prepped or partial inventory, convert volume to weight, handle POS modifiers, or keep menu prices in step with ingredient costs, so many never cost their menus at all.

indie-devs:reddit_intent_leads.name: Social buying-intent lead finder
indie-devs:reddit_intent_leads.idea: Monitors subreddits, X, and HN for posts that match a product's pain points, scores buying intent with an LLM, and sends a daily digest with draft replies to approve.
indie-devs:reddit_intent_leads.pain: Founders spend hours scanning Reddit, X, and LinkedIn for high-intent threads, competitor complaints, and buying signals. Keyword alerts and social listening tools are noisy, capped, or expensive, and posting replies risks spam flags. This cluster also covers the general 'can't get first users or distribution after launch' complaint.

data-analytics:recurring_report_automati.name: Recurring report and deck generation from many sources
data-analytics:recurring_report_automati.idea: Connect QuickBooks/HubSpot/Sheets once, and get the monthly KPI deck and Excel pack auto-refreshed into your own PowerPoint template with an AI-drafted commentary.
data-analytics:recurring_report_automati.pain: Finance and ops staff pull from QBO, HubSpot, ERP exports and spreadsheets into Excel and PowerPoint every month, fixing broken links and formatting, and writing board narratives by hand.

private-practice:documentation_burden.name: Progress note and documentation burden
private-practice:documentation_burden.idea: HIPAA-compliant AI note drafter that turns brief bullet points into payer-ready progress notes in each insurer's template, then copy-pastes into any EHR.
private-practice:documentation_burden.pain: Therapists and rehab clinicians fall behind on session notes, treatment plans, medical-necessity language and payer templates (including OASIS and 72-hour deadlines), and finish charting after hours in slow, click-heavy EMRs.

indie-devs:idea_validation.verdict: unviable — value per customer below the acquisition floor
indie-devs:idea_validation.name: Pain-point mining and idea validation
indie-devs:idea_validation.idea: A searchable database of recurring pain points from communities, grouped by industry, with a competitor check and a blunt viability score for each idea.
indie-devs:idea_validation.pain: Builders can't find validated, unsaturated problems people will pay to solve. They read threads by hand, find competitors only after building, get flattering AI feedback, and lack honest peer critique and accountability.

small-business:prospect_intent_finder.name: Lead and prospect discovery
small-business:prospect_intent_finder.idea: Alerts for local posts asking for your service and new permits/businesses in your area, with contact info.
small-business:prospect_intent_finder.pain: Service businesses and B2B sellers manually watch Facebook groups/Nextdoor for requests, dig through permit data, build local business lists, map mailing areas, and research prospects because paid lead marketplaces and cold outreach underperform.

nonprofit:grant_deadline_compliance_trac.name: Grant pipeline, deadline and post-award compliance tracker
nonprofit:grant_deadline_compliance_trac.idea: Upload an award letter or RFP to auto-build a deadline and deliverable calendar, with reminders sent to program staff and a multi-client view for freelancers.
nonprofit:grant_deadline_compliance_trac.pain: Overloaded development directors and multi-client freelancers track applications, deliverables, report and payment deadlines on multi-year grants, and recurring milestones in scattered spreadsheets. Deadlines are missed, especially after staff turnover, and post-award compliance work keeps growing.

bci:format_conversion_import.verdict: unviable — value per customer below the acquisition floor
bci:format_conversion_import.name: EEG file format import/conversion with annotations intact
bci:format_conversion_import.idea: Web/CLI universal EEG converter that validates events, units and channel labels before and after conversion and flags any data that changed silently.
bci:format_conversion_import.pain: EDF+/BDF, EGI MFF, Neuroscan, Nihon Kohden, BCI2000, OpenBCI/Muse CSV and SD-card exports fail to import, lose or shift annotations and events, garble units and scaling, or run out of memory. Moving data between EEGLAB, MNE and FieldTrip drops metadata, and JS/pandas/R readers are missing.

freelance-agency:marketplace_bid_optimiz.name: Marketplace bid & job-quality filter
freelance-agency:marketplace_bid_optimiz.idea: Browser extension that scores each Upwork job for hire likelihood and budget fit before you spend Connects, and tracks your proposal funnel and win rates.
freelance-agency:marketplace_bid_optimiz.pain: Freelancers burn paid Connects and boosts on ghost jobs, lowball listings, non-hiring clients and bot-flooded posts, and have no view of client hire rate, proposal status, win rates or where their funnel breaks.

recruiting-hr:high_volume_applicant_scre.name: High-volume applicant screening
recruiting-hr:high_volume_applicant_scre.idea: LLM screener that reads every application against the hiring manager's actual criteria, explains its rankings, flags false knockout answers and anonymizes names.
recruiting-hr:high_volume_applicant_scre.pain: Hundreds to thousands of mostly unqualified, mass or auto-applied applications per role; false knockout answers; keyword ATS filters that reject qualified, referred or non-standard candidates; name bias; messy resume files; no bulk triage in LinkedIn or small-company setups.
